description: A profile that accelerates to cruise speed and never decelerates. The trolley coasts through the target and eventually contacts the travel-envelope wall, which fails the run. (This is a proxy for the spec's dedicated 'automated profile ended while the system was still moving' failure reason (§7.2) — that specific gate isn't wired into the Milestone 0 engine yet, see the scope note in src/sim/engine.ts. Real crane-wall physics makes the run fail here regardless.)
